data.name: Karmzah
data.detailed_description:
KARMZAH 
Uncover ancient secrets. Fight for your legacy.

Morowa Adjei is an explorer who discovers a powerful artifact buried deep in the earth. That moment changes everything. She is transformed into Karmzah, a fast, powerful warrior with new abilities and a destiny to face. Alongside her clever guide, Muzu, she must battle strange creatures, escape deadly traps, and unlock the mysteries of a forgotten past.

Karmzah is a side-scrolling action-adventure game full of fast combat, tricky puzzles, and exciting platforming. Travel through beautiful, hand-crafted levels inspired by African stories and legends. Fight enemies using smooth combos and movement, learn new skills, and explore every corner of a rich and dangerous world.

As the story unfolds, you’ll need more than just strength to survive. Quick thinking, timing, and courage will carry you forward. Your journey is full of challenges, but also full of heart, humor, and discovery.

Whether you’re here for the action or the story, Karmzah offers a unique adventure with a bold art style, a fresh hero, and gameplay that keeps you moving.

 Features:

  • Fast-paced side-scrolling combat with creative, fluid movement

  • A story-driven adventure with rich characters and voice-acted dialogue

  • Beautiful environments inspired by African mythology and culture

  • Puzzles, traps, and secrets to discover in every level

  • A smart and funny sidekick who helps (and sometimes roasts) you

  • A fresh take on heroism, focusing on skill, wit, and determination

data.short_description: Karmzah is an action-adventure Side scroller set in a world of Sangoma. You’re Karmzah, a warrior chosen by MUZU—a mysterious spirit tied to ancient forces of balance. Use your super powered crutches to beat down all that stand in your way to rescue your friend.
